knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The return to work is set by the employer illness procedure, not by the worker own sense of being better or by a tablet. The other options are not reliable tests.
The guide advises keeping two or more days of clean clothing so that a change is always available. The other options do not give a change option.
The guide gives the reason that organisms can be picked up at home, in the car or on public transport. Cost and the scrubs-only option are not the reason.

practicalCriteria: Given a scenario with a symptomatic worker, the learner states that the worker stays away, names the person to tell, and does not give medical advice.
The learner demonstrates a clean-clothing check when a shift begins and names the action taken when a uniform is soiled.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the start-of-shift check
Record of a simulated absence notification
stopWorkCriteria: The worker has symptoms of a transmissible illness: do not start the shift and tell the supervisor.
Uniform is visibly soiled with body fluid: change it before continuing and follow the exposure procedure.
